children: Renewed US-Iran fighting and uncertainty over shipping through the Strait of Hormuz are pressuring global energy markets, while the threat of mines is still deterring some traffic, according to Bloomberg.

Ukraine’s attacks on Russian refineries are also worsening tight diesel supplies, and Bloomberg News Oil Products Reporter Will Kubzansky described the situation as a distillates crisis heading into peak demand season.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Iran, Ukraine Conflicts Tighten Global Energy Markets
